goal: Build broad and progressively deep knowledge required to become a capable founder who can build teams, build products, run a company, and make better decisions.

learning_model.description: Combine structured progression within each domain with adaptive and diverse daily feed selection.

foundation.description: Essential concepts and mental models that are prerequisites for deeper learning.

deep_progression.description: Concepts that should be learned progressively from intermediate to advanced levels.

current.description: Recent ideas, research, technologies, practices, and developments that should be understood before deciding whether to adopt them.
